# TODO — queued by relay-watch triage

## Why this is queued, not executed
relay-watch only reads/writes `.handoffs/*` and cannot touch worker code, scheduling, or ranking logic. This is follow-up engineering work, not urgent, but worth not losing.

## Source leg
`20260901T092814Z__claude-app__g-whoentertains` — mission-close report for the arch-B snapshot-serving rollout ("CLOSED: arch B verified... doctrine set"). Its "OPEN FOR OTHER LANES" section lists these as unfinished follow-ups.

## What it asks for
1. Worker should return an explicit "unavailable" response (rather than a misleading empty result) and pin reads to blade while the Space lags.
2. Schedule the snapshot publisher (currently presumably manual/ad hoc).
3. Add an RRF (reciprocal rank fusion) relevance floor.

## Not part of this TODO
The same source leg also lists "UPS for the Stadium (the original physical root cause, still unbought)" — that's a hardware purchase, not code, and isn't included here. Flagging for GM/ops awareness only.

## Done when
Whichever lane picks this up should confirm with the source leg's author (g-whoentertains / claude-cli on blade1tb) what "explicit unavailable" should look like at the API/connector boundary before implementing, since it affects the truth-state contract discussed in the separate temporal-provenance TODO (`20260901T085258Z__ccr__claude-cli`).
